At SAIF , actuaries are more than our numbers people. Their work is the thread that binds together our enterprise-wide projects, strategies, and mission.

Heavily relied-upon for their creativity and expertise, this team has the autonomy to work directly with business partners to help establish rates, maintain adequate reserves, produce forecasts, and ensure long term stability.

As our new senior actuarial analyst, you'll play a vital role in SAIF 's mission to serve Oregon's workers and employers by making workers' compensation coverage widely available and affordable, and by providing extraordinary service.

We're looking for a highly motivated self-starter with actuarial experience, but just as importantly, we're seeking a collaborative teammate, strategic communicator, seeker of challenges and opportunities, and champion of analytics. Your work won't be done in isolation.

You will work closely with a seasoned team of actuaries and analysts in a fast-paced, high pressure environment and collaborate regularly with partners across the company. You will work directly with senior executives and influence critical work for our customers, board members, regulators, and other stakeholders.

The impact and visibility of your work could reach the four corners of the state and beyond. Note: This position is open to remote candidates, however, due to some state restrictions there are some locations that SAIF is not able to hire remote candidates.

Remote workers will be required to travel to SAIF 's office in Salem, Oregon, a few times per year.

Development of reasonable loss and loss adjustment expense reserves.
Preparation of various inputs to the annual and quarter financial statements and related filings and participation in regulatory audits.
Development and filing of sound rate recommendations, maintenance of SAIF ’s pricing and rate adequacy monitoring tools, conducting trend and market analysis research, and providing support to Underwriting on individual account pricing and the development of technical underwriting guidelines.
Updates to and maintenance of SAIF ’s financial forecasts, dividend models, capital models, and surplus analyses. Completion of supporting documentation and communication including the Own Risk Solvency Assessment (ORSA).
Support for SAIF ’s reinsurance program and monitoring of reinsurance coverage including claim reporting, commutations, and financial reporting.
NCCI financial data call process, including calculating any data anomalies and communicating with NCCI to explain SAIF ’s data and answer questions.
Conduct research and analysis that contributes to recommendations that inform strategic priorities related to actuarial analysis and planning.
Participate in the design and execution of data analysis, and support to various external and internal customers, including auditors, reinsurers, and reinsurance brokers, SAIF ’s appointed actuary and staff, and SAIF ’s executive leadership team and board of directors.
Monitor external information sources for developments that may affect SAIF ’s operations and strategies, including such areas as regional business conditions, competitors, demographics, legal or regulatory changes, and medical costs, utilization, treatment patterns and practices, medical outcomes, and healthcare policy. Assess potential impacts and assist with the preparation of recommendations to inform management response.
Stay abreast of trends and innovations in the casualty actuarial profession related to pricing, reserving, workers’ compensation, and related areas.
Serve as a consultant and resource for internal and external business information, pro-active problem resolution, and the application of analytical techniques.
Work closely with the Data & Analytics function to monitor and inform data integrity and incorporate the use of analytics to inform decisions.
Coach others in the use and interpretation of standard actuarial procedures.
Explore diverse perspectives and consistently behave sensitively toward differences in cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating. Work effectively with others who have different perspectives, backgrounds, and/or work styles.
Perform other duties as assigned by management to support team objectives and organizational goals, demonstrating flexibility and adaptability in responding to evolving priorities and needs.

Four years of actuarial experience, including experience supporting actuarial reserving, pricing, or financial modeling in the insurance industry. Experience in workers’ compensation insurance strongly preferred.
A bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, economics, finance, or a related field. Continued progress towards or maintenance of membership in the Casualty Actuarial Society in accordance with the guidelines established by SAIF ’s Actuarial Study and Professionalism Program. Progress towards membership in the Casualty Actuary Society including completion of CAS exam 5 or exam 6.

Are you a qualified actuary ready to step into a role where technical excellence meets commercial strategy? Do you thrive at the intersection of pricing leadership, portfolio performance and senior stakeholder influence - in one of the world's most international reinsurance environments? If this sounds like you, Swiss Re wants to hear from you.

As a Senior Actuary in the Continental Europe Market Unit, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's Life & Health business - shaping strategy, driving portfolio performance and acting as a trusted actuarial voice across markets. This is a role that blends deep technical expertise with real commercial impact, offering you the opportunity to lead, influence and make a difference at scale.

· Act as Chief Actuary for one or more Continental European markets, providing technical leadership and oversight of pricing decisions, referrals and key actuarial assumptions
· Monitor portfolio performance continuously - identifying emerging opportunities and risks, and supporting the design and execution of value-enhancing management actions
· Partner cross-functionally with Client Management, Underwriting, Valuation and Portfolio Management teams to identify and unlock opportunities to enhance portfolio value
· Influence strategic decisions by acting as a trusted counterpart to Inforce Optimisation and Portfolio Management teams - bringing constructive challenge and sharp actuarial insight
· Lead actuarial assessments supporting repricing initiatives, recaptures, in-force transactions and other high-impact strategic projects
· Contribute to client discussions, transaction structuring and negotiations, bringing both actuarial rigour and commercial perspective to the table
· Support governance processes through referral reviews and independent actuarial challenge, ensuring robust decision-making frameworks
· Connect the dots across the actuarial control cycle - building an end-to-end understanding of the business and feeding consistent insights back to the relevant teams
· Represent your markets and contribute to selected Continental Europe cross-functional initiatives, broadening your impact beyond your core portfolio
· Coach and support less experienced actuaries, actively contributing to a culture of technical excellence and continuous development across the organisation

You will join a vibrant and highly collaborative Continental Europe actuarial community, working closely with colleagues across Client Management, Underwriting, Valuation, Pricing and Portfolio Management. The team is deeply embedded in Swiss Re's Life & Health business and plays a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of one of the most diverse and dynamic reinsurance portfolios in the region.
This role offers broad exposure to strategic initiatives, senior stakeholders and a rich variety of Life & Health products and markets - making it an exceptional opportunity for an actuary who is ready to grow their leadership footprint in a truly international setting.

We are looking for a commercially minded, technically strong actuary who brings both depth of expertise and the confidence to challenge and influence at the most senior levels. You are someone who can translate complex actuarial insights into clear business recommendations, build trusted relationships across functions, and lead initiatives independently in a fast-paced, international environment.

s.h: We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements
s.t:
· Qualified actuary (SAV, DAV, FIA, FSA or equivalent) with significant actuarial experience in life insurance, health insurance or reinsurance
· Strong technical grounding in pricing, valuation, portfolio management or related actuarial disciplines, with a demonstrated ability to assess portfolio performance and translate findings into actionable business recommendations
· Proven stakeholder influence - a track record of constructively challenging and engaging senior stakeholders, driving outcomes across organisational boundaries
· Commercial acumen - a solid understanding of reinsurance value drivers and the ability to bring commercial judgement to actuarial work
· Excellent communication skills - the ability to present complex actuarial topics clearly and compellingly to both technical and non-technical audiences, combined with fluency in English

As Senior Client Manager & Actuary L&H for Italy, you will be accountable for the **end-to-end performance** of your L&H Italian client portfolio - combining deep actuarial expertise with commercial accountability and strategic client engagement. You will be responsible for the overall performance, development, and market positioning of Swiss Re across your client base, ensuring consistent and high-quality delivery across Core reinsurance, solutions, transactions, and value-added services.
Operating in a collaborative matrix environment, you will work closely with Pricing, Underwriting, Claims, Technical Accounting, Reserving, Solutions, and Transactions teams, while maintaining clear ownership of client outcomes.

* **Own the client relationship end-to-end:** Serve as the central point of contact for your L&H clients in Italy, ensuring seamless communication and consistently high-quality service delivery
* **Develop and execute growth strategies:** Identify and implement opportunities for existing and prospective clients, leveraging actuarial expertise in pricing, product development, and portfolio steering
